title: Google launches five free AI tools for content, design, and #googleai #aitoolslaunch #aiautomation
description: Google released five free AI tools designed to save businesses thousands of dollars monthly. These tools include Pameli for automated social media content strategies, Opal for building AI workflows through plain English commands, Mixboard for creating and remixing AI-generated images, Stitch for rapid UI design from text prompts, and Antigravity for AI-assisted code generation. This development reflects how quickly AI innovations are moving from experimental phases into practical applications with real business impact. By automating creative, technical, and strategic tasks, these tools empower companies to increase efficiency and reduce costs in marketing, design, and development processes. The release signals a broader shift toward accessible AI integration in diverse workflows, highlighting the growing role of AI in transforming productivity and creativity across industries. #GoogleAI #Pameli #OpalAI #Mixboard #StitchAI #Antigravity #AItools #AIAutomation #ArtificialIntelligence #AIDesign #AICoding #TechInnovation #BusinessEfficiency #AIProductivity #DigitalTransformation
